claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brushes as very soft and good at blending and applying makeup evenly.
Many reviewers consider the set a great value for the price.
A common complaint is that the handles feel weak, creak, crack, or fall off.
Several reviewers bought the brushes as gifts and report the recipients loved them.
Some reviewers were disappointed with the quality, citing stiff or hardening bristles and poor performance.
